spans.s:
बिश् बिश् (= rt. पिस्), cl. 1. P. बेशति, &c.,
to go.

बिस् बिस् (sometimes written विस्, q. v.),
cl. 4. P. बिस्यति, &c., to go, move; to
split; to grow; to urge on, incite; to cast, throw.
बिश बिश, बिष, various forms for बिस, q. v.

बिस, अम्, n. (in classical Sanskrit more usually
written विस, q. v.), a shoot, sucker; the film or
fibres of the stalk of the water-lily, that part of the
stalk of the lotus which is underground, (the young
shoots of the Nelumbium and of various species of
the Nymphæa, particularly of the Nymphæa Edulis,
as well as the parts of the stalk underground, appear
to have been eaten as a delicacy; at the end of an
adj. comp. बिस forms the fem. in आ); the whole
lotus plant (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 7974).
—बिस-खा,
आस्, m., Ved. one who digs for the stalks of roots, a
digger for the fibres of the stem of the lotus, (also
written विष-खा.)
—बिस-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
abounding in lotus fibres; (अती), f. a place abounding
in lotus fibres.

बिष्कला बिष्कला, f., Ved. parturient, a
woman in travail; [cf. बिल्ल-सू, बष्कय, बष्-
किह; according to some a masc. form विष्कल or
बिष्कल exists, = ग्राम्य-शूकर, a tame hog,
which by reason of its fecundity has the name बह्व्-
अपत्य, having much offspring.]
